tools.name: resolve_vehicle
tools.description: Resolve a VIN or year/make/model safely. MATCHED_SINGLE is answerable; NEEDS_IDENTITY requires the user to choose; NO_MATCH/UNAVAILABLE must not be guessed.

tools.name: get_vehicle_specs
tools.description: Return MCP-permitted normalized specifications for one safely resolved AUTO411 configuration.

tools.name: get_vehicle_fitment
tools.description: Return vehicle fitment facts including tires and available wheel fitment specifications such as bolt pattern, center bore, offset, and thread size.

tools.name: get_vehicle_safety
tools.description: Return NHTSA YMM-scoped recalls, complaints, investigations, communications, and safety ratings. These facts never prove configuration identity.

tools.name: get_vehicle_efficiency
tools.description: Return EPA efficiency only when the EPA candidate is safely selected; otherwise return NEEDS_IDENTITY or NO_MATCH.
